import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    k = r - l
    even = k // 2 + 1
    odd = (k + 1) // 2
    pr = 998244353
    
    product = n * m
    if product % 2 == 1:
        result = pow(k + 1, product, pr)
        print(result, end='')
    else:
        even_plus_odd = even + odd  # equals k+1
        even_minus_odd = even - odd
        temp1 = pow(even_plus_odd, product, pr)
        temp2 = pow(even_minus_odd, product, pr)
        result = (temp1 + temp2) * ((pr + 1) // 2) % pr
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
